from decimal import Decimal,DecimalTuple
import random
random.seed(7)
print(type(x).__name__,x==2,hash(x)==hash(2),x+1)
print(Decimal(x)==Decimal(2),Decimal(1)+x)
print(len(random.sample(range(8),x)),0<=random.getrandbits(x)<4)
t=DecimalTuple(0,(x,),x)
print(Decimal(t)==Decimal(200),t.digits,t.exponent)
